title: Senior Manager, Accounting Operations
text:
About Commonwealth Fusion Systems: 
 
Commonwealth Fusion Systems is on a mission to deliver the urgent transition to fusion energy.
 
Combining decades of research, top talent, and new technologies, we’re designing and building commercially viable fusion power plants. And we're working with policymakers, suppliers, and many others to build the energy industry of the future.
 
We’re in the best position to make it happen. Since 2018, we’ve raised $4 billion of capital, making us the largest and leading fusion company in the world.
 
Now we’re looking for more thinkers, doers, builders, and makers to join us. People who’ll bring new perspectives, solve tough problems, and thrive as part of a team. 
 
If that’s you and this role fits, we want to hear from you.


Join the power movement as Senior Manager, Accounting Operations
 
Our Accounting team is looking for a transformational leader to own and optimize our operational accounting functions. This person must have a broad knowledge of accounting and experience in developing and scaling a talented team. The Senior Manager, Accounting Operations acts as a connector between our Accounting function and adjacent teams including Payroll, Supply Chain, Manufacturing, etc. We are looking for someone who is anticipatory and able to look five steps ahead in the process to see how accounting decisions affect everything part of our organization. The role is structural in nature: it creates one clear owner for work that is currently fragmented across staff, consultants, and senior accounting leadership, reducing operational bottlenecks and helping the Accounting organization scale as CFS grows.You will lead us through optimization efforts to develop and implement best practices and effective systems as we continue to scale the company, but also won't be afraid to be hands-on when necessary. This role has immense opportunity for growth as our team continues to grow and develop.

What you'll do:: 
 Evaluate, recommend, and implement process improvements for accounting operations, including analyzing potential system enhancements and developing SOPs

 Own collaboration with Supply Chain, FP&A, People Ops, IT, etc. to ensure optimized processes and cross-functional communication

 Manage and develop the AP, payroll, expense reporting, and state filing compliance team and operations; build role clarity, cross-training, backup coverage, and accountability

 Serve as the first-line manager-level owner for operational accounting issue triage, escalation handling, root-cause follow-up, and process discipline

 Document key operating procedures, create scalable SOPs and training materials, and ensure process changes are communicated and adopted across impacted functions

 Monitor operational accounting metrics and recurring issues to identify trends, reduce rework, and improve processing accuracy and cycle time

 
What we’re looking for:: 
 Bachelor’s degree in Business Administration or Accounting or similar field preferred

 Minimum of 7 years of relevant accounting, accounting operations, or finance operations experience

 Minimum of 5 years of supervisory, team lead, or process-owner experience in a finance/accounting environment

 Hands-on experience with AP, payroll coordination, expense reporting, state filing compliance, or related operational accounting workflows

 Demonstrated experience improving processes, resolving operational bottlenecks, documenting procedures, and driving accountability across functions

 Experience working cross-functionally with teams such as Supply Chain, FP&A, People Ops/HR, ERP/IT, operations, or procurement

 Strong process ownership, issue triage, prioritization, and root-cause problem-solving skills

 Ability to manage ambiguity, create structure, and operate effectively in a fast-paced environment

 Strong communication skills and ability to partner with non-accounting stakeholders while maintaining compliance and control discipline

 People leadership, coaching, staff development, and accountability management

 Strong Excel and ERP fluency; ability to use data to identify exceptions, trends, and process gaps

 
Bonus points for: : 
 Experience in a high-growth, manufacturing, R&D, project-based, or operationally complex environment

 Experience with Odoo or similar ERP systems

 Experience managing external providers for state filings, compliance, payroll support, or related services

 Experience with corporate card programs, travel and expense systems, procure-to-pay workflows, or payroll systems

 CPA, CPP, or other relevant professional certification 

 Experience building SOPs, training materials, controls documentation, and audit-ready support

 
Must-have Requirements: : 
 Perform extended activities such as typing, standing, sitting, walking, etc.

 Occasional nights/weekends/on-call may be required during payroll processing, month-end close, audit, compliance deadlines, system issues, or urgent operational escalations.

 Work in a facility that contains industrial hazards including heat, cold, noise, fumes, strong magnets, lead (Pb), high voltage, high current, pressure systems, and cryogenics


#LI-Hybrid


At CFS, we excel in fast-paced environments, driven by our values of integrity, execution, impact, and self-critique. As we grow, we’re eager to bring on mission-driven folks who offer diverse perspectives and fresh ways to tackle challenges.
 
We value diversity deeply and are proud to be an equal opportunity employer by choice. We consider all qualified applicants equally, regardless of race, color, national origin, ancestry, citizenship status, protected veteran status, religion, physical or mental disability, marital status, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, age, or any other basis protected by law.
 
This role requires compliance with U.S. laws concerning the export of controlled or protected technologies or information (collectively, “Export Control Laws"). Any offer of employment will be contingent on the need for compliance with such Export Control Laws.
